methodology.exact_duplicate_definition: Review text after trimming surrounding whitespace; case-sensitive.
methodology.near_duplicate_similarity: TF-IDF cosine similarity over character n-grams using char_wb and 3-5 character n-grams.
methodology.near_duplicate_pair_counting: Unique unordered review pairs within training; every training/test pair across datasets.
methodology.repeated_phrase_method: Distinct 3-6 word phrases counted once per review.

near_duplicate_examples.review_2: I booked a local appliance technician to handle a microwave that stopped responding. The technician arrived promptly, worked carefully, and left the kitchen tidy.

most_common_repeated_sentences.sentence: the food arrived cold and late, despite the delivery time being confirmed.
every meal was labeled correctly, arrived hot, and was ready at the agreed time.
an unapproved add-on appeared on the final bill with no explanation.
the washer still will not drain, and my follow-up request was ignored.
the order contained six meals and came in labeled containers.
the visit lasted about an hour, and a written estimate was provided.
the joinery is sturdy and neat, with careful attention to the finish.
the service receipt lists the inspection and the materials used.

assessment.template_evidence: High pairwise near-duplicate count, repeated exact sentence clauses, repeated phrase patterns, and an average of nearly two sentences per review.
assessment.style_and_domain_summary: Both datasets cover local services. Training reviews are substantially longer and typically use two-part repeated sentence frames; independent-test reviews are shorter, predominantly one sentence, and use less repeated wording.
